THE PROBLEM

Millions of STEM students pass exams on topics they can’t actually use.

Theory is taught without working labs. Complex ideas are locked in dense English handouts. And when a student gets stuck at 11 PM, there is nobody there to explain it simply.

📚 Cram & Forget

Formulas memorised for grades, gone a week later.

🔬 No Lab Access

Most schools lack working equipment for every student.

🌙 Stuck Alone at Night

Zero 1-on-1 support outside lecture hours.

WHY IT MATTERS

By the time the gap shows up on exam day, it’s too late for everyone.

FOR STUDENTS

Forced to cram abstract equations without ever touching a circuit or simulation. One missed concept snowballs into failing the course.

FOR LECTURERS

Managing 100 to 500+ students with zero time to build custom simulations, audio lessons and adaptive practice for every single topic.

FOR SCHOOLS & EMPLOYERS

Lecturers only discover who was lost after final exams are graded, producing graduates with paper grades but no hands-on build confidence.

THE SUNROOT SOLUTION

A 24/7 AI tutor and virtual lab for every student, and a live mastery radar for every teacher.

HOW IT WORKS · TEACHER IN CONTROL

From course syllabus to full interactive classroom in minutes.

1

Drop the Syllabus

Lecturer uploads their course outline or lecture notes.

2

AI Builds the Topic

Clear notes, a 2-host podcast, a live simulation and a 60-question practice bank.

3

Lecturer Approves

Nothing goes live until the teacher reviews, edits and pushes it.

4

Students Learn 4 Ways

Read & listen in 8 languages, simulate, practise, build in 3D.

5

Live Mastery Radar

Every quiz answer and circuit build updates each student’s skill score.

THE STUDENT EXPERIENCE

Every topic, four ways in, so no learner gets left behind.

1 · Read & Listen

2-voice podcast & notes in English, Pidgin, Yorùbá, Igbo, Hausa, French, Arabic & Swahili.

2 · Simulate

Interactive physics & circuit sliders that make equations visible.

3 · Practice

Adaptive flashcards & quizzes that focus on weak spots.

4 · Prove It

Hands-on circuit & Arduino bench where students build it from scratch.
